decisions.reason: Because it builds directly on the firm's core piezo inkjet and marking knowledge, the firm can readily interpret and improve its early results, making withdrawal unlikely.
The software module extends the firm's existing variable-data printing and software portfolio, so related knowledge supports learning and further development rather than dropping.
As an inkjet coder for new surfaces, it leverages the firm's ink and substrate expertise, allowing the firm to absorb feedback and keep improving the product.
The mobile decoding app builds on the firm's prior PharmaScan app and code-reading knowledge, so the firm has enough absorptive capacity to justify retaining it.
The inline verification system is closely tied to the firm's traceability and marking solutions, and its existing integration knowledge makes it easier to learn from field experience.
The layout design software complements the firm's printing systems and software capabilities, enabling the firm to assimilate user feedback and continue development.
